crossRefs.note: She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember…
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

translations.web: I prayed for this child, and Yahweh has given me my petition which I asked of him.
translations.bsb: I prayed for this boy, and since the LORD has granted me what I asked of Him,
translations.kjv: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
translations.asv: For this child I prayed; and Jehovah hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
